name: @pipeworx/mcp-nhtsa

tools.name: decode_vin
tools.description: Decode a VIN to get vehicle details. Returns make, model, year, body style, engine type, drivetrain, and plant. E.g., '1HGBH41JXMN109186'. (For recalls/ratings use get_recalls / get_safety_ratings.)

tools.name: get_makes
tools.description: Get all vehicle brands for a model year. Returns make names and IDs. E.g., year '2023'.

tools.name: get_models
tools.description: Get all vehicle models for a make and year. Returns model names and IDs. E.g., make 'Toyota', year '2023'.

tools.name: get_recalls
tools.description: Get official NHTSA safety RECALLS for a vehicle. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "is my car recalled", "recalls on a 2021 Honda Civic", "open recalls for make/model/year". Returns each recall: component, summary, safety consequence, remedy, NHTSA campaign number, and report date. Pass make + model + model_year.

tools.name: get_complaints
tools.description: Get owner-filed NHTSA complaints for a vehicle — real-world problems drivers reported (vs official recalls). Use for "common problems with a 2020 Ford Explorer", "what are owners complaining about". Returns components, summary, crash/fire flags, injuries/deaths, and filing date. Pass make + model + model_year.

tools.name: get_safety_ratings
tools.description: Get NHTSA 5-Star Safety Ratings (NCAP crash-test results) for a vehicle — overall, frontal, side, and rollover star ratings. Use for "crash test rating for a 2021 Honda Civic", "how safe is X". Pass make + model + model_year.

tools.name: fars_state_fatalities
tools.description: Fatal motor-vehicle crash counts and fatalities for a US state, from NHTSA's Fatality Analysis Reporting System (FARS). Pass a state (full name like "Texas", 2-letter postal code like "TX", or FIPS code) and a year. Returns monthly rows: crashes, fatalities, persons involved, vehicles involved, pedestrians involved. Omit year to get every loaded year/month for that state. Covers a recent multi-year window (see data_as_of and call fars_coverage for the exact range), not full FARS history. Unknown states are refused with a clear error, never an empty success.

state.description: State name ("Texas"), 2-letter postal code ("TX"), or FIPS code ("48").

year.description: Optional: calendar year, e.g. 2023. Omit to return every loaded year for this state.

tools.name: fars_vehicle_makes
tools.description: Vehicle makes involved in fatal crashes nationwide for a given year, from NHTSA FARS. Pass year alone to get the top makes ranked by vehicle-involvement count (e.g. "which vehicle makes show up most in fatal crashes in 2023"); pass make as well to get that one make's involvement count across every loaded year. This is an INVOLVEMENT count, not a claim that the make caused the crash. Unknown makes are refused with a clear error naming a few valid makes, never an empty success.

year.description: Calendar year, e.g. 2023. Required unless make is given (then optional, scoping to one year).

limit.description: Max makes to return when ranking by year. Default 20, max 50.

tools.name: fars_coverage
tools.description: What FARS fatal-crash data this pack actually has loaded right now: the earliest and latest year covered and when it was last loaded. Call this before fars_state_fatalities/fars_vehicle_makes if unsure a given year is covered.

tools.name: fuel_economy_mpg
tools.description: EPA fuel-economy ratings (city/highway/combined MPG, CO2 g/mile, fuel type) for a specific model year + make + model, from fueleconomy.gov (DOE/EPA), proxied live. Pass the model string exactly as fueleconomy.gov lists it (e.g. "Camry", "F-150 2WD", "Model 3") -- if unsure, call fuel_economy_models first to see valid model strings for that year+make. A model year/make/model can have several engine/transmission/drivetrain VARIANTS; this returns up to 5, each with its own MPG. Unknown make/model/year combos are refused with a clear error (never an empty success) and, when the make or model itself is not recognized for that year, list a few valid options.

model.description: Vehicle model exactly as fueleconomy.gov lists it, e.g. "Camry". Call fuel_economy_models to see valid strings.

tools.name: fuel_economy_models
tools.description: List the exact model strings fueleconomy.gov recognizes for a given model year + make (e.g. year 2024, make "Toyota" -> "Camry", "Camry Hybrid LE", "RAV4 AWD", ...). Call this before fuel_economy_mpg when you are not sure of the exact model string, or when fuel_economy_mpg refuses a model as unrecognized.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-nhtsa forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the nhtsa pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
